We get a single interpretive glimpse of Carlo, whose eyes seem ashamed of the light they cannot share with his blind brother. No other perspectives are explored. No morally ambiguous or unlikeable character is developed enough for their mindset to be rendered convincingly. Geronimo's drinking hints at complexity, but his motives and thoughts are not entered.
